      Review window: Sep 18, 2026 - Sep 28, 2026

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Dylan Leslie_, Sep 28, 2026, 1/5: "just a money flip. answer loads of questions and sign up for a week trial. then they say they want 25 A MONTH! for body weight exercises 😂 then before the app has still showed me anything it's trying to sell me add ons for abs. couldn't care how good the app is, 2.50 for body weight app I understand but u want the price of a gym membership😂😂 immediately cancelled"
            2. _Gayle Warren_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "I thought I had cancelled this correctly via email. But I see you took a payment from my Visa without consent. $89.99 please ensure my account/subscription is CANCELLED I don't require it!"

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: May 23, 2026 - Sep 28, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Engin Volkan_, Sep 23, 2026, 1/5: "30 day money back guarantee has conditions which is only visible in the details of their policy. Do not assume that you can easily change your mind in 30 days. Once they have your money, they'll hold on to that as much as possible like they'll ask for screenshots and proof of usage for 7 days. How exactly is this a guarantee? Check their policy and don't be fooled with their ads. Buggy onboarding, survey keeps crashing, support manually changed it two times, but I still need proof, right..."
